measurable_outcome: An immutable typed input/output and fail-closed golden-master contract exists for applying the registered MiniBooNE verdict policy before any source extraction or closure revalidation.

method.framework: MAPE-K plus requirements traceability, typed design by contract, golden-master analysis and fail-closed mutation testing

external_sources.use: requirements information items and traceable requirements engineering

external_sources.source: NASA Systems Engineering Handbook Appendix D
external_sources.use: unique requirement identifiers and definitive verification matrix
software V&V traceability and checking intended and unintended behavior

prohibited_side_effects: scientific CSV or Stage 5 verdict modification

public_contracts.name: build_verdict_evidence_record
public_contracts.input: registered claim plus canonical ST05_01-ST05_07 DataFrames
public_contracts.responsibility: validate identities, schemas and provenance and derive typed facts without selecting a category

public_contracts.name: evaluate_registered_verdict_conditions
public_contracts.output: one VerdictConditionEvaluationV01 per category and clause
public_contracts.responsibility: bind each prose policy clause to a versioned category-specific evaluator; emit indeterminate rather than guess an undefined qualitative threshold

public_contracts.name: apply_registered_verdict_policy
public_contracts.input: validated policy, evidence record and condition evaluations
public_contracts.responsibility: apply categories in strict descending decision_rank order and stop fail-closed on incomplete or indeterminate higher-rank evidence

public_contracts.name: validate_verdict_policy_application_bundle
public_contracts.input: policy, evidence record, condition evaluations and result
public_contracts.responsibility: verify identity, completeness, ordering, hashes, result derivation and language/disclosure constraints

invariants: all identity fields are nonblank and exactly match the registered claim and every policy row
all required source hashes and schemas are validated before facts are derived
all counts are internally consistent and all numeric facts are finite
primary and secondary comparisons use paired outer validation blocks and directional candidate advantage
the evidence record contains facts only and cannot supply a selected category
unknown or ambiguous source state is represented as indeterminate and never coerced to pass

condition_evaluation_contract.semantic_rule: The engine never parses Russian prose heuristically. A versioned evaluator implements each category clause. Undefined terms such as near zero or systematically must yield INDETERMINATE until their policy semantics are explicitly registered by an authorized task.

application_algorithm: validate the policy as exactly six unique rows with one policy_id, one claim_id, unique category_id and decision_rank, nonblank five clauses and ranks 6 through 1
validate the evidence record identity, facts, source hashes and evaluator_contract_id
sort policy rows by decision_rank descending irrespective of CSV row order
for each category require exactly five keyed condition evaluations from the registered evaluator version
if any clause is INDETERMINATE before a category match, return INDETERMINATE_FAIL_CLOSED with no selected category
if all five clauses are PASS, select that category, copy its exact allowed and forbidden language, calculate mandatory disclosures and mark all lower ranks NOT_EVALUATED_AFTER_MATCH
if at least one clause is FAIL and none is indeterminate, continue to the next lower rank
if no category matches, return NO_CATEGORY_MATCH_FAIL_CLOSED with no selected category
validate the resulting category, rank, clause outcomes, disclosure flags and source digest against the inputs

invariants: a selected category exists if and only if application_status is APPLIED
selected rank and language are copied from exactly one validated policy row
a cost ratio greater than 10 requires high_training_cost disclosure
result cannot broaden the claim beyond MiniBooNE and registered protocols
result generation performs no training and does not modify source evidence

positive_checks: exact policy identity, 6x16 schema, ranks and category order
independent reconstruction of all golden facts from protected canonical evidence
ranked selection returns strongly_supported and exact policy language
golden result matches historical ST05_08 category without changing it
boundary_checks: positive share 0.95 passes and a value below 0.95 fails
mean delta 0.03 passes and a value below 0.03 fails
q05 above 0.01 passes while exactly 0.01 fails
secondary support share 0.90 passes and a value below 0.90 fails
fit ratio exactly 10 does not trigger high-cost disclosure while a value above 10 does
negative_mutations: selected language not copied from policy

verification_result.repair: Historical ST07_31-ST07_33 gates now verify task-specific evidence and durable chain facts rather than requiring their old status to remain the current global status.

design_verdict.uncertainty: The lower-rank policy rows contain qualitative terms that are not fully operationalized. The contract requires INDETERMINATE_FAIL_CLOSED rather than silently inventing thresholds.

proposed_next_block.measurable_outcome: Implement the ST07_34 contracts in src/mlcra/verdicts.py and validate the historical strongly_supported golden path plus all boundary and fail-closed mutations without changing policy, evidence or verdict.
